blockingIssues.problem: The description tells borrowers to collect their reserved tools "at any time during desk opening hours," which contradicts the source statement that the pickup window printed on each confirmation still applies.
blockingIssues.sourceEvidence: Source: "The pickup window printed on each confirmation still applies."
blockingIssues.constraint: The notice must preserve that borrowers are bound by the pickup window shown on their confirmation; it cannot state or imply they may collect at any time during desk opening hours unless the source explicitly allows that.
